neighbours.label: ' and' after 'electron(s)' in solid-state physics, expecting the partner carrier (holes, ions)
fire: In a doped crystal, the mobile carriers are electrons and holes.
The plasma contains free electrons and positive ions.
An incoming photon creates a pair of electrons and holes in silicon.
Current in the cell is carried by electrons and ions.
The junction separates the negative electrons and the positive holes.
Solar absorbers generate both electrons and holes when illuminated.
A charge pair, an electron and a hole, then forms in the layer.
Recombination happens when electrons and holes meet in the diode.
quiet: In a doped crystal, the atoms are arranged in a cubic lattice.
The plasma contains hot gas and strong magnetic fields.
An incoming photon heats the surface of silicon and the oxide.
Current in the cell is limited by resistors and wiring.
The junction separates the copper and the aluminium layers.
Solar absorbers generate both heat and glare when illuminated.
The nucleus has neutrons and protons, tightly bound in the core.
Recombination happens when atoms and molecules meet in the chamber.

notes: The output promotes ' holes', ' hole', ' spin'. 'protons and' reads weakly in a probe and is one of the near misses.
